modules.name: Learn
modules.title: What Is Reported Speech?
modules.instructions: Master direct vs. reported speech, reporting verbs (say/tell/ask), and basic pronoun shifts. Understand when and why we report what others say.

modules.name: Write
modules.title: Basic Reported Statements
modules.instructions: Write simple reported statements using said/told + that-clause. Practice pronoun changes and removing quotation marks.

modules.name: Play
modules.title: Speech Transformation Games
modules.instructions: Play games to practice converting direct quotes to reported form. Recognize reporting verbs and basic structure patterns.

modules.name: Apply
modules.title: Reporting Vocabulary Challenge
modules.instructions: Apply reporting verbs, pronouns, and basic connectors correctly. Master foundational reported speech vocabulary.
